key_insight: Hierarchical mathematical hints provide intermediate milestones that shorten the reasoning horizon and improve reinforcement learning for multi-step problem solving.
engineering_relevance: Structured sub-question checkpoints offer a way to strengthen verifiable-reward training beyond final-answer feedback.
method: Use intrinsic sub-question structure to construct logically grounded hierarchical hints.
Condition reasoning on these intermediate milestones rather than relying only on chain-of-thought prompting.
Integrate hierarchical hints into RL training through Hierarchical Hint-Based Reward (H²R).
evidence_signal: On the introduced HiMath benchmark, H²R raises Qwen2.5-Math-7B accuracy from 30.4% to 39.1% with hierarchical hints and to 45.6% with oracle hierarchical hints.
watch_item: Performance depends on reliable intermediate hints; oracle-hint results may overstate gains achievable when hints must be generated automatically.
paper_title: H$^2$R: Hierarchical Hint-Based Reward for Mathematical Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
